name: Four Islands Speedboat Tour
tagline: Phra Nang, Chicken Island, Tub & Poda in one perfect day
taglineZh: 一天玩遍帕南洞、鸡岛、塔布岛与波达岛
description: The classic Krabi day trip: speedboat across to Railay's Phra Nang Cave Beach, Chicken Island with its famous viewpoint, the sandbar walk to Tub Island at low tide, and snorkelling off Poda — with beach lunch included.
descriptionZh: 甲米经典一日游：快艇前往莱利的帕南洞海滩、著名观景鸡岛，退潮时经沙洲步行至塔布岛，再到波达岛浮潜——含海滩午餐。

location.address: Ao Nang Beach Pier, Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi 81000

name: Hong Islands Tour by Speedboat
tagline: Lagoons and limestone islets of the Krabi archipelago
taglineZh: 甲米群岛的泻湖与石灰岩小岛
description: Cruise to the stunning Hong archipelago — Hong Lagoon, Hong Island's white-sand beach, Lading (Paradise) Island and Pakbia — best visited early or late to enjoy the emerald water before the crowds arrive.
descriptionZh: 乘快艇畅游甲米绝美的红岛群岛——红岛泻湖、红岛白沙滩、天堂岛与 Pakbia 岛。建议选择早出或晚归班次，在人潮到来前独享翡翠般的海水。

location.address: Ao Nang Beach Pier, Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi 81000

name: Emerald Pool & Hot Springs Jungle Tour
nameZh: 翡翠池与温泉丛林一日游
tagline: Swim in a jungle pool and soak in natural hot springs
taglineZh: 丛林翡翠池畅游，天然温泉舒泡
description: Head south to Klong Thom for a jungle day: swim in the vivid Emerald Pool (Sa Morakot), soak in the natural hot-spring cascades of Namtok Ron, and explore the Blue Pool trail inside Thung Teao Forest National Park.
descriptionZh: 南下空通县开启丛林一日游：在翡翠色的翡翠池（Sa Morakot）畅游，泡在暖热的天然温泉瀑布中，再徒步蓝池步道，探索 Thung Teao 国家森林。

services.name: Emerald Pool & Hot Springs Day Tour
Combo: Crystal Lagoon & Tiger Cave Temple

location.address: Thung Teao Forest National Park, Klong Thom Nuea, Krabi 81120
